notes:
Anivora 0.1.48 · Android version code 50

- Independent Anivora public API for catalogue/provider requests, with bounded caching and no large media relay. Existing account and Google sign-in services stay on Render/MongoDB.
- Preserved all 15 anime provider identities and priorities. Native direct adapters remain available; providers with no verified interface report unavailability honestly. Upstream restrictions still affect AniList and several anime providers.
- Verified Chainsaw Man chapter lists/page URLs from WeebCentral, MangaPill and MangaKatana. Selected manga providers load on demand. Black-and-white source artwork is unchanged.
- Official website moves to anivora1.pages.dev. Old website and Render title links remain supported. Android retains all three website associations.
- Smooth normal navigation, tab and selection transitions, checkboxes, reader switches and UI-thread sliders. Saved Reduce Animations and system reduced motion are respected. Player-specific behavior is preserved.
- Independent menu movement and gradual background dimming, with dismissal cleanup and stable token-entry dialogs.
- Update notes have See More and a draggable full description. A verified download requests Android installation while the app is active; cancelled installation reuses the saved verified APK.
- Optional Profile rewarded-ad integration with signed server verification and account-backed points: exactly 10 points per verified ad. Production ads are disabled until genuine AdMob IDs and approvals are configured. No shop, redemption or feature unlocks.
- Durable, replay-safe new-human-member welcomes in the existing Discord welcome channel. No fabricated public welcome was sent during verification.
- Smaller health responses, a separate Render readiness probe, consistent connectivity wording, silent Syncing… notifications and a reviewed Android permission set.

Install over your existing Anivora app; do not uninstall. Original package and signing certificate are retained. Build, checksum and verification details accompany the APK publication. Physical Infinix/XOS, an attached Cast receiver and actual AdMob serving require device/owner configuration checks and are not claimed as tested here.
